title: Coefficients of a product
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f,g:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb F_2$. For every coordinate subset $U$, the algebraic normal form coefficient of the pointwise product $fg$ at $U$ equals the sum, over all pairs of coordinate subsets $S,T$ with $S\cup T=U$, of the product of the coefficient of $f$ at $S$ and the coefficient of $g$ at $T$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ and $g$ are Boolean functions on the $n$-dimensional cube
